evidence.title: Utah surface ownership
claims: Best-effort 1:24,000 surface ownership, maintained by SITLA/BLM and partners; ownership differs from management or jurisdiction.
Polygons are context, never permission to camp or cross private land.
evidence.geometry_status: source-native WGS84 GeoJSON; exact map envelope intersects in EPSG:26912; full features retained; independent counts and exact object-ID sets verified

evidence.title: Barracks Kiosk
claims: Several dispersed camping sites are described along the river. Barracks Ranch is private.
Kiosk is unimproved staging with no water or other amenities. Roads beyond ranch are not recommended for street or two-wheel-drive vehicles.
Published kiosk coordinate is a reference point, not a campsite polygon or measured horse-trailer turnaround.
evidence.horse_trailer_camping: unverified rig fit; dispersed opportunity documented

evidence.title: Coyote Hollow
claims: Equestrian campground; current listing makes all sites reservable with equestrian priority.
Seasonal nonpotable stock water can run out in late summer or early fall; Red Canyon Campground dump station water is the published fallback.
Older USFS equestrian brochure saying no reservations is outdated relative to current listing.
evidence.horse_trailer_camping: designated equestrian campground; check site dimensions and reservation

evidence.title: Dixie occupancy and use
claims: Developed sites: at most 14 consecutive days and 14 days per 30-day period.
Camping within 10 miles of same location: at most 16 consecutive days and 16 days per 60-day period.
Closed developed sites and parking against posted instructions prohibited.
evidence.temporal_status: within stated term; subject to rescission

evidence.title: Powell and Cedar City posted water sources
claims: Camping and parking within 300 feet of designated water sources posted with the respective restriction signs are prohibited.
Not a blanket buffer around every mapped stream, spring, trough or campground hydrant.
evidence.geometry_status: official Powell reference JPEG retained; no invented polygon

evidence.title: Seasonal livestock corral restrictions
claims: At listed corrals when posted, no camping within 300 feet May 1–November 15; obey posted parking instructions.
Powell list: Daves Hollow #306502, Daves Hollow G.S. #306501, East Fork #306504, Day #313500, Mud Springs #317502 and #317501, Permittee #306505.
The BLM Barracks corrals are not inferred to be covered by this USFS order.
evidence.geometry_status: named list and attachment maps only; no precise GIS geometry created

evidence.title: Tom Best historic roadside restriction
claims: Historical restriction on signed mapped portions of roads 117,130,646 and 150 feet either side.
Expired May 15, 2026. No replacement was located on live alerts index or targeted official searches. This does not prove camping is currently permitted.

evidence.title: East Fork Sevier historic restriction
claims: Order limited camping to designated sites in its mapped corridor and unattended equipment to 24 hours.
Its own term ended June 30, 2026 even though the alert remains listed. No replacement located.
This East Fork is the Sevier River near Tropic Reservoir, not the East Fork Virgin River at Barracks.

evidence.title: Daves Hollow camping
claims: Mapped restriction area allows camping only at designated areas/sites; unattended camping equipment limited to 24 hours without officer permission.
Official map retained as reference; no polygon was reconstructed from township prose.

evidence.title: GSENM trip planning
claims: Free permits are required for all overnight stays in GSENM, available at visitor centers or developed trailheads.
This does not designate horse-trailer parking or waive site-specific restrictions.

evidence.title: Paria Canyon permits
claims: Backcountry overnight permits must be reserved in advance; use existing campsites at least 200 feet from water; Wrather Canyon closed to camping.
Wilderness excludes motor vehicles: a backcountry permit never authorizes a trailer camp inside it.
Campfires prohibited; pack out human waste. Current page does not establish horse-specific camp locations.

evidence.title: Utah Trust Lands recreation
claims: Camping allowed on most trust land for up to 15 consecutive days; some areas have 7-day limits or closures.
Use existing durable campsites at least 100 feet from water. Do not leave equipment unattended more than 72 hours; motorized parking over 100 feet from authorized routes prohibited.
Trust lands are not public lands; verify parcel-specific access. Current page says open campfires prohibited.

evidence.title: White House campground
claims: Published as seven car-camping and five walk-in tent sites.
Not documented as an equestrian campground; do not assume horse or long-trailer accommodation.

evidence.title: Powell camping overview
claims: Search-index map labels Tom Best, East Fork and Daves Hollow restriction areas.
Old overview is not proof of currently effective restrictions; Tom Best and East Fork cited orders expired in 2026.

rule: No public ownership polygon is designated camping permission. No restriction boundary fabricated from prose. Current seasonal closures and on-site signs still control.
